About

How it works

LLM Deals provides verified pricing data for AI models, helping you find the best value.

Verified Pricing

All pricing data is collected directly from official provider websites and documentation. We verify each price point against official sources before including it in our database.

Deal Analysis

We analyze subscription deals, credits, and promotions to calculate effective token prices. This means you can compare deals across different pricing models - from pay-as-you-go to subscription credits.

OpenCode Go Integration

LLM Deals integrates with OpenCode Go to provide real-time pricing for their managed API. OpenCode Go offers a $10/month subscription with $60 of included usage across multiple AI models.

Data Freshness

We regularly check provider websites for pricing updates. Each data point includes when it was last verified, so you know how current the information is.
